Document No 3 - Heads of Terms (summary of key terms, Updated 12.10.26)
- Lease term: 10 years.
- Sinking fund: the operator contributes GBP 2,500 per annum.
- Car park: the operator pays 50% of car park running costs.
- Drains, plant, gas and water: the operator pays 16% of shared costs.
- No schedule of condition will be provided.
- Planning conditions 12, 13, 52 and 55 apply to the use of the building (opening hours and noise).
- Start: Spring 2027.
